ask: ok this is a mess, do your thing and tell us who owes who
sentence: Tracks shared trip expenses in a group chat, works out each person's balance, and shows the fewest payments needed to settle up, with a button to mark a payment as made.
use_when: A group has paid for things separately on a trip or weekend and needs to know who owes who
Some costs were shared by everyone and some by only a few people
People want to add expenses and mark payments as paid as they go
The group wants the smallest number of transfers to even out
dont_use_when: Splitting a single restaurant bill by items or with tax and tip on one receipt
Tracking a long-term budget, loan, or recurring household bills with currency conversion
Actually sending money, since it only records payments and does not move funds
